hook.text: When should you send your wedding invitations?

tips.title: 4 to 6 months before
tips.text: Save the date (9 months if guests travel)

tips.title: 6 to 8 weeks before
tips.text: The invitation with all the details

tips.title: 2 to 3 weeks before
tips.text: Follow up with anyone who hasn't replied

tips.title: 1 to 2 weeks before
tips.text: Give the final count to your venue and caterer

cta.text: With In-Vite you set an RSVP deadline, guests reply in one tap and you get a WhatsApp alert for each one
